import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    R = int(data[0])
    out_lines = []
    for i in range(1, R + 1):
        # descending from the i-th letter down to 'A'
        down = [chr(ord('A') + j) for j in range(i - 1, -1, -1)]
        # ascending from 'B' up to the i-th letter
        up = [chr(ord('A') + j) for j in range(1, i)]
        out_lines.append(''.join(down + up))
    sys.stdout.write('\n'.join(out_lines))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
